replyContent: By default, Telegram sends new login codes to a user’s other active *Telegram apps* when a user is logged in on multiple devices. On the mobile apps, there is the option to request an SMS code instead – from ‘Send as SMS’ on the login page. For security reasons, the Web and Desktop apps can’t send SMS codes, only login codes to other Telegram apps.
